title: UR5e joint backlash
subtitle: gear_backlash's UR plant on QDD drivetrains
summary: Menagerie's UR5e on QDD-style drivetrains (gear_backlash's UR study plant): each joint a motor hinge with its rotor as armature, a gear gap and a tuned mesh stop, then the link. The description takes each gap at a QDD planetary's datasheet value; the arm's gaps are larger. The routine is gear_backlash's own gravity-crossing sweep: from the motor encoders and motor torques only, it finds each gravity-loadable joint's two flanks and so its gap.
